name: context7
description: Context7 MCP — up-to-date library docs fetched on demand. Resolves library IDs and returns current API/usage snippets. Requires CONTEXT7_API_KEY.
post_install_message:
Store the API key in macOS keychain BEFORE install (or re-install after):
  security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s "CONTEXT7_API_KEY" -w "ctx7sk-XXXXXX"
Installer reads it via:
  security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s "CONTEXT7_API_KEY" -w
